title.zh: 火焰管与磁镜压强裕度

summary: Calculate source-defined firehose and mirror margin fields, their sampled minima and positivity flags from anisotropic pressure and magnetic-field values.

identity.relation: Anisotropic pressures and magnetic-field samples to two sampled margin criteria
identity.direction: (p_parallel, p_perp, B, mu0) -> firehose_margin, mirror_margin, minima and positivity flags
identity.definition: firehose_margin=B^2/mu0+p_perp-p_parallel; mirror_margin=B^2/mu0-B*d(p_perp)/dB. Flatten samples, sort by B, take a first-order-edge finite gradient in B-value space, then restore the original shape. Each stable flag means the corresponding minimum over supplied samples is strictly positive.
identity.model: Saved Pleiades anisotropic-pressure margin diagnostic; positive sampled margins are necessary outcomes of these implemented criteria, not a general proof of plasma stability
identity.geometry: No spatial grid geometry is used; array dimensions preserve sample layout only
identity.coordinates: The mirror derivative is with respect to sorted magnetic-field values, not spatial position or array index
identity.boundary: With one sample or B range at most 1e-30, the mirror derivative is zero. With a nondegenerate B range, adjacent sorted B samples must differ by more than 1e-30.
assumptions: p_parallel and p_perp are pressure values in Pa sampled consistently with B in tesla.
The caller has independently established that this finite B-value derivative and these sampled margin criteria are appropriate for its equilibrium model.

inputs.name: p_parallel
inputs.shape: nonempty scalar or array; exactly the same shape as p_perp and magnetic_field
inputs.constraints: Finite; negative values are not rejected.

inputs.name: p_perp
inputs.description: Perpendicular pressure samples and value-space derivative input.
inputs.shape: exactly the same shape as p_parallel
inputs.constraints: Finite; negative values are not rejected.

inputs.name: magnetic_field
inputs.description: Magnetic-field samples for the B^2/mu0 magnetic-tension contribution and the B-value derivative.
inputs.shape: exactly the same shape as p_parallel
inputs.constraints: Finite; all-equal samples are accepted, while duplicates or near duplicates within 1e-30 are rejected in a nondegenerate sample set.

inputs.name: mu0
inputs.description: Magnetic permeability used in the B^2/mu0 terms.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; the default is 4*pi*1e-7.

inputs.name: parallel_equilibrium
inputs.description: Optional upstream diagnostic dictionary; only error and max_relative_error fields are forwarded.
inputs.constraints: When present, must be a dict. The two forwarded values are not independently validated for shape, units or finiteness.

outputs.name: mirror_margin
outputs.description: Pointwise B^2/mu0-B*d(p_perp)/dB using the global B-sorted sample derivative.

outputs.name: firehose_stable
outputs.description: True exactly when every supplied firehose margin is strictly positive.
outputs.constraints: A sampled aggregate flag, not a spatially resolved stability field or sufficient physical stability theorem.

outputs.name: mirror_stable
outputs.description: True exactly when every supplied mirror margin is strictly positive.
outputs.constraints: A sampled aggregate flag, not a spatially resolved stability field or sufficient physical stability theorem.

outputs.name: min_firehose_margin
outputs.description: Minimum firehose margin across all samples.

outputs.name: min_mirror_margin
outputs.description: Minimum mirror margin across all samples.

outputs.name: parallel_equilibrium_error
outputs.description: Unmodified parallel_equilibrium.error value, or None when absent.
outputs.units: upstream-defined, normally Pa, or not applicable
outputs.constraints: No independent numeric, unit, shape or finite check.

outputs.name: max_parallel_equilibrium_error
outputs.description: Unmodified parallel_equilibrium.max_relative_error value, or None when absent.
outputs.units: upstream-defined, normally dimensionless, or not applicable
outputs.constraints: No independent numeric, unit or finite check.

preconditions: Both pressure arrays and magnetic-field values refer to the same nonempty sample set and share an exact shape.
The caller has selected a physically meaningful B-value coordinate and criterion for interpreting the margins.
supported: Finite scalar and array sample sets, including unsorted B values.
All-equal B samples under the explicit zero-derivative convention and a resolved B range without near-duplicate values.
excluded: A spatial pressure gradient, kinetic instability calculation, mode growth rate or full equilibrium stability proof.
Automatic physical validation of negative pressures, field orientation or forwarded parallel-equilibrium evidence.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for mismatched shape, nonfinite pressures/field, nonpositive or nonfinite mu0, a non-dict parallel_equilibrium, or duplicate B values in a nondegenerate sample set. An empty sample set fails during the minimum reduction rather than yielding a result.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the B-value derivative or either margin becomes nonfinite; other unexpected NumPy conversion or reduction errors may propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative stability or equilibrium solve is performed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None; both margin fields and aggregate flags are returned together, while optional upstream fields are forwarded unchanged.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel maintains the firehose/mirror margin relation from saved Pleiades development-migration material. The prior candidate record has a validation gap and is neither current qualified D1 source evidence nor expert approval. The formulas here are the implemented sampled diagnostic, not a claim that all physical firehose or mirror instability criteria are covered.
source_kinds: saved Pleiades operator descriptor and migration provenance
SciRel direct formula, value-space and duplicate-field regression tests

example.description: Evaluate both sampled margins with unsorted B values and a linear perpendicular-pressure profile.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.diagnostics import compute_firehose_mirror_margins
B = np.array([2.0, 1.0, 3.0, 1.5])
p_perp = 5.0 + 3.0 * B
r = compute_firehose_mirror_margins(p_perp + 2.0, p_perp, B)
mu0 = 4.0e-7 * np.pi
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['firehose_margin'], B * B / mu0 - 2.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['mirror_margin'], B * B / mu0 - 3.0 * B)
assert r['firehose_stable'] and r['mirror_stable']
example.expected: The B-sorted derivative is 3 Pa/T despite unsorted input, giving the two stated positive margin arrays in original sample order.

scope: Constant-pressure analytic margins and negative firehose-margin flag.
Unsorted linear p_perp(B) derivative, all-equal B zero-derivative convention and duplicate nondegenerate B rejection.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests establish the listed finite-sample formulas and numerical branches. They do not establish a current qualified source oracle, derivative convergence, full spatial or kinetic stability, or expert scientific approval.
known_limitations: Flattening pools all positions into one B-sorted derivative; array adjacency and geometry are ignored.
All-equal B forces a zero derivative even when perpendicular pressure values differ.
The stable flags summarize only strict positivity at supplied samples; they are not general stability conclusions.
The optional upstream diagnostic values are forwarded without scientific validation.
Public distribution licensing and expert recognition remain pending.
